name: ostler
displayName: Ostler: a real browser for AI agents
description: Adds the Ostler MCP browser to VS Code: read pages, research with checked citations, fill forms. No Rust, no terminal, no config files.

commands.title: Ostler: Sign in to a website

ostler.path.markdownDescription: Path to an `ostler` binary. Leave empty to use the one on your PATH, or to download the matching release once.

ostler.headed.description: Show the Chrome window while the assistant works.

ostler.cautious.markdownDescription: Block page requests that change things unless the assistant uses the confirmed `form_submit` step (`--require-confirm-submit`). Stricter; can also stop some sign-ins.

ostler.profileDir.markdownDescription: Keep sign-ins in this folder (`--profile-dir`). Create the session first with the **Ostler: Sign in to a website** command.
